subtitle: Instrument bay, fully offline
promotional_text: An on-device instrument bay. Fit the horn, open the map, and keep a private field book.
description: Clefbay is a complete offline instrument game. Finish onboarding, follow Walk through four moves, run Four Columns, choose a Range for the bay clock, and save a Tablet note. Home opens the fit bench, the world map, the shelf, the shop, the instrument card, and a phone-only hall board. Tap Bell, Valve, Slide, and Mouth to build the horn. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Stars, hints, and notes stay on the device.
app_review_notes: Clefbay is a fully offline instrument game and private field book. Review flow: complete onboarding, open Walk and advance the four moves, start Four Columns, choose a Range, then save a Tablet note. On Home, tap Bell, Valve, Slide, and Mouth to mark the horn built. Map, shelf, shop, card, and hall board are local screens. No sign-in, network calls, camera, or photo library access.
